requirements.required_behavior: Limit the label length to at most 63 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded label length can be measured and checked against the 63-octet limit.

requirements.required_behavior: Limit the name length to at most 255 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded name length can be measured and checked against the 255-octet limit.

requirements.quote: TTL             positive values of a signed 32 bit number.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit TTL values to positive values representable by a signed 32-bit number.
requirements.why_checkable: The TTL value can be checked for positivity and against the signed 32-bit numeric range.

requirements.condition: For a DNS message transported using UDP.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit the message length to at most 512 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The DNS message length carried over UDP can be measured and checked against the 512-octet limit.
